clues.label: Plot
clues.value: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary ▇▇▇ finds himself pushed to the brink—and suddenly, the champion who once ruled the track is fighting just to stay in the race. With his career hanging in the balance, ▇▇▇ must turn to an ambitious young race technician with a plan of her own, draw strength from the legacy of the late Fabulous ▇▇▇ Hornet, and risk everything on one last shot at glory.
